from collections import defaultdict
import heapq

def main():
    N = int(input())

    G = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(1, N):
        a, b, x = map(int, input().split())
        G[i - 1].append((i, a))
        G[i - 1].append((x - 1, b))

    dist = [float('inf')] * N
    dist[0] = 0
    q = [(0, 0)]
    heapq.heapify(q)
    while len(q) > 0:
        v = heapq.heappop(q)[1]
        for next in G[v]:
            if dist[next[0]] > dist[v] + next[1]:
                dist[next[0]] = dist[v] + next[1]
                heapq.heappush(q, (dist[next[0]], next[0]))
    print(dist[N - 1])
